main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: HENRICUS WELSINGIUS, Pastor Ec-clesiæ S. Martensdyckanæ, in diœcesi Ultrajectinâ, qui edidit Libellum FAUSTI SOCINI, de Officio hominis Christiani in hodiernis istis de Religione controversijs: cui etiam præfixit Præfationem suam, quâ Libellum hunc Evangelicis commendat, ut satis nervosè tractantem id quod auctor sibi propositerat, monetque eos ut diligenter hunc Libellum legant, & unicè attendant, non quis, sed quid dicat: docetque Evangelicos magno cum fructu hunc Libellum legere posse, utpote qui ex eo agnituri sint, multa sibi deesse adhuc ad veram Religionis puritatem: multa etiam quæ pugnent cum illâ imprudenter adhuc in cœtibus suis retineri.

page.notes: The printed "propofuerat" has been read as "propositerat"; the scan is faint at that word, so please check it. The third pastor's entry is set in small capitals; I have written them in full capitals. The lower part of the page carries faint show-through of the verso (names of other pastors), which is left out. No page number or running head is printed.
